Name: Ahiman, Porter
Summary: Porter in the companies of the children of Levi, brother of Shallum.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:17: Porter in the companies of the children of Levi, brother of Shallum.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ahiman in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
